name: slopocop
description: Clear development communication and targeted prose editing across agents. Three skills: palych for concise, technically precise RU/EN replies, questions and progress; humanizer-ru for Russian text; slop-humanizer for English text or requested prose. Use when improving agent communication, humanizing text or auditing prose. Includes Claude Code hooks, trusted Codex hooks, an OMP extension and a host-neutral installer for the consuming agent's startup instructions, all using one Palych core. Editorial commands and the slop-cop reviewer remain Claude-native. No per-reply audit or runtime network downloads.
